decision_reason: ONT and Illumina RNA recover the same canonical AFF3 coding splice across the affected intron, with no altered exon boundary or deletion-specific RNA junction.
dna_only: The focal deletion is wholly intronic in every inspected Ensembl 87 coding transcript; an altered protein would require a demonstrated splice or regulatory consequence.
epitope_message: Not predicted because no altered coding RNA or mutant protein sequence was observed.
interpretation: Long reads add multi-exon isoform linkage and short reads add local junction support, but the mature coding sequence is identical on both platforms and supplies no mutant peptide.
limitation: Mature RNA cannot directly retain evidence for a small deletion inside a constitutively removed intron; this audit does not test every possible regulatory effect.

platform_comparison.conclusion: Both platforms recover the same canonical coding splice across the affected intron; the 128-bp DNA deletion is absent from mature coding RNA and creates no observed peptide difference.
platform_comparison.dna_model: chr2:99668095-99668223 lies wholly inside the intron between ENST00000317233 exons ending at 99649666 and starting at 99672538; no Ensembl 87 coding exon overlaps it.
